_notes: Equipment diagrams on the BizMan vehicle page, rendered by art/tools/render_diagrams.sh. Per kind: the image (in unity/FoodTrucks/UI), its size in pixels, the suggested icon size as a fraction of the image height (a 0.40 m piece), and the places in the order VehicleDisplays fills them. x runs right and y down, 0 to 1 of the image; x/y is the icon centre (0.22 m above the place, about the middle of a piece), baseX/baseY the place itself on the counter. Keys starting with an underscore are notes.
